original_question: White piedra and black piedra are infections of the hair shaft caused by organisms of which taxonomic domain?

final_qi.question: What taxonomic domain causes white piedra infections of the hair shaft?
final_qi.long_answer: White piedra is produced by yeast-like fungi of the genus Trichosporon. All fungi are nucleated, membrane-bound organisms classified in the taxonomic domain Eukarya, so the causative agents of white piedra are eukaryotes.
